item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
# Battery Sensei 1.0
First public release of Battery Sensei — a quiet macOS menu-bar utility that watches your battery and nudges you to plug in before it bites.
## What's inside
- **Customisable warnings.** Three calm presets (gentle banner, persistent badge, full-screen kamehameha) plus a "Custom" tier where you set thresholds, snooze rules, auto-dismiss, and styles per rule. - **Today.** Live capacity, cycle count, time-since-plug-in, and a soft history strip so you can see what your battery has been through this week. - **Sensei Saga.** Per-app battery share over the last 1 h / 24 h / 7 d, ranked. Tap a row for a chart and detail card. Search to drill in. - **Calendar guard.** Optional read-only calendar access so Sensei can warn you when the battery won't last through your next meeting. - **Charge cap recommendations.** Daily limit with weekly full-cycle reminders to keep the gauge honest. - **Auto-update via Sparkle.** Signed EdDSA + Apple-notarized PKGs delivered straight from `battery-sensei.app`.
## Languages
English, Deutsch, Español, Français, 日本語 — fully localized including notifications, share cards, calendar alerts, and accessibility labels.
## Requires
- macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later - Apple Silicon or Intel - Calendar access is optional and read-only
Drag the installer into Applications and Sensei takes it from there.
